question: What length adjustment applies when the width is measured in platform parts?
premises: The width is extended in platform parts
The length is increased relative to that width
inference: When measured in platform parts, the length should be two parts greater than the width.
uncertainties: The exact value of jagatyāṃśe is not stated in this verse
plain_english: When the width is extended in platform parts, the length should be two parts greater.
